**sdd/issue-221-c2b1-machinery/apply-progress**

**What**: Fix pass on C2b-1 (#221) addressing an adversarial review (BLOCKER + MAJOR + 2 MINOR), on branch feat/issue-221-c2b1-machinery, committed as a176c36 (new commit, did NOT amend 3811b5d). All 4 fixes done via strict TDD (RED test first, then GREEN implementation). Combined with the original C2b-1 apply-progress (topic same key, this entry supersedes/extends it — original 4 phases + this Phase 5 are ALL complete).

**Why**: Reviewer found: `dualWriteRecords` duplicated records on every `share` (no dedup), silently dropped errored/rejected/skipped/unparseable observations (violating the epistemic-honesty standard `buildMigrationReport` was already held to), ran the records append BEFORE the chunk backstop (so a chunk-only secret could abort after records/ was already mutated), and `spec.md`/`design.md` over-claimed `scrubRecordsFile` as wired into live `share` when it isn't.

**Where**:
- MODIFIED `brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.mjs` — added `readRecordIds({ recordsDir })`: reads every `records/*.jsonl` file, returns a `Set<string>` of ids (authoritative existing-id source, not the derived index.jsonl). Corrupt lines are skipped here (not this function's fail-closed gate — `rebuildIndex` still owns that).
- MODIFIED `brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.test.mjs` — +4 tests for `readRecordIds` (absent dir, empty dir, multi-file collection, corrupt-line skip).
- MODIFIED `brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs`:
  - `_defaultReadObservations` now EXPORTED and returns `{observations, unparseable, emptyObservations}` (was: just the flattened observations array) — reuses `collectChunkObservations` verbatim.
  - `dualWriteRecords(root, opts)` rewritten: per-observation accounting (`errored`/`rejected`/`skippedPersonal` counters replace the old silent `continue`/filter-only logic), then id-dedup via `_readRecordIds` (default `readRecordIds`) against existing records/ AND within-batch (`seenInBatch` Set) BEFORE appending. Returns `{written, deduped, errored, rejected, skippedPersonal, unparseableChunks, emptyObservationsChunks, indexCount?}` — every observation named in exactly one bucket, zero fields stay present (mirrors `buildMigrationReport`).
  - `share()` reordered: `export → scrubMaterializedChunks (chunk backstop) → dualWriteRecords (records)` (was: dual-write then backstop) — chunk backstop is now unconditional-first so a chunk-only secret can never abort after records/ was mutated.
- MODIFIED `brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.share.test.mjs` — updated all `_readObservations` seam call sites to the new `{observations, unparseable, emptyObservations}` shape; updated the 2 ordering tests to assert the NEW order (chunk backstop runs first, `chunkScrubRan` flips from `false` to `true` in the secret-abort test); added: 3 idempotency tests (2nd identical share appends 0 lines; partial-new batch appends only the new one; within-batch duplicate collapses to 1 line), 1 full-accounting test (1 clean + 1 throwing + 1 scope:personal + 1 non-enum → `written:1,errored:1,skippedPersonal:1,rejected:1`), 1 chunk-bucket test, 1 `_defaultReadObservations` unit test (real gzip fixtures: good/empty/corrupt chunk). Net +6 tests in this file, +4 in store.test.mjs = +10 total (1024 → 1034).
- MODIFIED `openspec/changes/issue-221-c2b1-machinery/spec.md` — REQ-C2B1-2 retitled/corrected ("tested cutover seam, not wired into share this slice"); REQ-C2B1-3 expanded with the dedup + honest-accounting contract and 2 new scenarios (idempotent repeat share; every-fate-accounted-for).
- MODIFIED `openspec/changes/issue-221-c2b1-machinery/design.md` — Decision 3 corrected to match (scrubRecordsFile is C2b-2's future seam); Decision 1 gained a "Reorder (fix pass)" paragraph + an "Accepted residual note" (a chunk-only secret discovered by some later/manual scan after a clean dualWriteRecords append is accepted risk, narrowed by the reorder + id-dedup).
- `openspec/changes/issue-221-c2b1-machinery/tasks.md` — new Phase 5 (fix pass), all 7 sub-tasks `[x]`.

**Learned**:
- Changing `_defaultReadObservations`'s return contract (array → `{observations, unparseable, emptyObservations}`) required updating EVERY test call site that injected `_readObservations` as a seam (11 call sites) — this is expected mechanical churn when a seam's contract changes, not a TDD violation, since all call sites are the SAME function's test surface.
- `readRecordIds` deliberately does NOT fail closed on a corrupt physical line — dedup input is best-effort; `rebuildIndex` remains the ONE fail-closed integrity gate over records/. A corrupt line still fails the next `rebuildIndex()` call with the same file:line convention.
- The "chunk-only secret" scenario (an observation the records candidate filter excludes, e.g. scope:personal, but which is still present raw in the materialized chunk file) is exactly why the reorder matters: dualWriteRecords' candidate scan can never see it, only the chunk backstop can.
- Budget: fix-pass diff (excl. `*.test.mjs`, `openspec/changes/**`) = 162 counted lines (engram.mjs 97+30, store.mjs 35+0). Combined with the original C2b-1 slice's ~211 → ~373 cumulative for this not-yet-merged slice, still under 400.
- Full `npm test` = 1034 passing (was 1024 baseline before this fix pass). `brain:repo:check` and `brain:nav` both green. `.memory/` (real store) confirmed untouched (git status clean on that path) throughout.
- Committed as a176c36 on feat/issue-221-c2b1-machinery, NOT pushed, no PR opened, did NOT amend 3811b5d (per instructions — new commit only).
